## Step 1 — Confirm escalated perspectives

## Step 4 — Run per-perspective checklists: Cognitive & Neurodivergent

| Checklist Item | WCAG Criterion | Status | Evidence / Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Error messages suggest specific corrective action, not just "invalid input" | 3.3.3 | **PASS** | Messages are explicit: `"Email address is required."`, `"Please enter a valid email address."`, `"Password must be at least 8 characters."` All indicate what is needed or wrong. |
| Multi-step forms do not re-ask information provided in earlier steps | 3.3.7 | **N/A** | Single-step form; criterion does not apply. |
| Authentication does not require transcription, memorization, or puzzle-solving; paste and autofill work | 3.3.8 | **PASS** | `autoComplete="email"` and `autoComplete="current-password"` are present. No CAPTCHA, cognitive test, or paste-blocking logic detected. |
| Navigation appears in same relative position across all pages | 3.2.3 | **N/A** | Single-component review; cross-page consistency out of scope. |
| Components with same function have consistent labels/icons across pages | 3.2.4 | **N/A** | Single-component review. |
| Help mechanism appears in same location on every page | 3.2.6 | **N/A** | Single-component review. |
| Focus on element does not auto-trigger context change | 3.2.1 | **PASS** | `onChange` handlers only clear field errors (`clearFieldError`). No focus-triggered navigation, modals, or state changes. |
| Changing form control value does not auto-submit or auto-navigate | 3.2.2 | **PASS** | Form submission is strictly bound to the `"Sign In"` button click or native Enter key on inputs. No `onChange`-driven submit. |
| Destructive actions have undo, confirmation, or review step | 3.3.4 | **N/A** | No destructive actions present in this component. |
| More than one way to reach any page (search, nav, sitemap, breadcrumbs) | 2.4.5 | **N/A** | Single-component review. |
| Input fields for personal data have appropriate `autocomplete` attributes | 1.3.5 | **PASS** | `autoComplete="email"` on email field; `autoComplete="current-password"` on password field. Matches WCAG 1.3.5 intent. |
| Timeout warnings give ≥ 20 seconds to extend | 2.2.1 | **N/A** | No session timeouts or auto-expiry logic in markup/JS. |
| Content avoids unexplained jargon, undefined abbreviations, complex sentences | Cognitive AA | **PASS** | Plain language used throughout. Labels and error text are direct and unambiguous. |

**Neurodivergent-Specific Checks:**
- [x] Page layout is predictable — main content in expected location, no layout shifts → **PASS** (Static centered container, standard DOM order, no CLS triggers)
- [x] Visual hierarchy is clear — headings, spacing, and grouping guide reading order → **PASS** (`h1` → conditional error summary → labeled fields → submit button → help links. Consistent `margin-bottom` spacing)
- [x] No autoplay media or unprompted modal dialogs → **PASS** (None present)
- [x] Instructions don't rely on memory of previous steps → **PASS** (Single-step flow, inline labels, immediate error association via `aria-describedby`)

**Red Flags Check:**
- CAPTCHA/cognitive test with no accessible alternative: Not present.
- Paste disabled on auth fields: Not present.
- Multi-step form re-collecting data: N/A.
- Destructive action with no confirmation: N/A.
- All red flags cleared.

**Code vs Content Separation:**
- Code-level findings: None.
- Content-level findings: None. (All error text and labels are present in source; no external media or dynamic content requiring human verification.)
